title: 20 第20章 外门风云21 第21章 执法队
content_zh:
陈大正心中疑惑，不知道为什么方长老要亲自来。
“难道宝器出问题了？”
陈大正想道，“不应该啊，要真是出问题，就不是这个语气了。”
他快速的向着外门弟子住宿区跑去，看来只有找到林轩，才能知道是怎么回事。
不过，让他更加头疼的是林轩根本就不在房间内，陈大正询问了周围的弟子，没人知道林轩去了哪里。
无奈，他只能硬着头皮回去禀告方长老。
方长老听后，捋了捋胡子：“等他回来，让他立刻来见我。”
“是。”
陈大正恭声说道。
等方长老走后，陈大正突然一拍额头：“哎呀，忘了我手里还有一柄林轩刚修好的宝刀！”
“算了，等林轩回来，在送去吧。”
他现在可不敢跑去找方长老，只能期待林轩快点回来了。
于此同时，这玄天宗的外门，一场风暴即将来临。
神威团的弟子发动全部力量去搜寻张彬死前接触过的人，结果一名方脸的弟子说出了一则惊人的消息。
他和别人争斗受伤，张彬是看到他发出的信号，过去援救他的。
后来张彬等人追踪那人到山林深处，最后死在了山林之中。
最后，神威团的弟子画出了林轩的样貌，一场搜捕林轩的行动在外门展开。
多方探寻，终于摸清了林轩的底细。
“一个剑奴，刚加入外门？”
一个脸色有刀疤的少年听到这话后，勃然大怒，“你觉得他能杀死一个四阶灵士和两个三阶灵士！”

这少年是神威团的外门负责人之一，叫做严空，一身修为达到了凝脉境六阶。
此时他听到林轩的消息后不禁大怒。
“空哥。”
那方脸弟子哆哆嗦嗦的说道，“我和那叫林轩的打斗时，发现他虽然是三阶灵士，但是实力却远超三阶。”
“空哥，反正现在就这一个线索，不管是不是，先抓来再说，不然张锐回来后，我们没法交代。”
严空身旁的弟子说道。
“走，先去看看！”
严空大手一挥，带着一群人朝着林轩的住所走去。
……
外门弟子的居住区，突然出现一群神威团的弟子，他们快速的包围了一个小屋，其中一弟子一脚将屋门踢烂。
居住在周围的弟子纷纷出来，望着一群气势汹汹的神威团弟子，都是一脸茫然的表情。
“空哥，那小子不在！”
有人进去探查了一番，然后出来说道。
“不在？难道跑了？”
严空眉头紧皱，“赶紧派人去搜索宗门附近，分一部分人在这里等着，我就不信，他还能跑到天上去！”
一声令下，神威团的外门弟子开始飞快的行动起来，而周围的弟子也渐渐明白了他们的举动，林轩这个名字第一次被大家认知。
而当他们知道林轩不过是一个刚加入外门的小弟子，没有任何背景和依靠时，顿时有种发昏的感觉，果然是无知者无畏，一个小弟子竟然敢挑衅神威团这样的庞然大物。
唐玉听到这个消息后，赶紧跑去找林轩，她没想到林轩竟然惹出这么大的乱子，不但找了神威团的麻烦，而且还杀了人！
她急匆匆的跑向林轩的住所，生怕林轩已经被神威团带走了。
不过还好，除了见到一屋子的神威团弟子外，根本没有看到林轩的影子。

“小混蛋，还知道逃跑，哼！”
唐玉在心中不停的骂着林轩。
转了一圈没有发现林轩，她恨恨的跺了跺脚，然后气呼呼的走掉了。
content_en:
Chen Dazheng was confused and didn't know why Elder Fang came in person.
"Is there something wrong with the treasure?"
Chen Dazheng thought, "That shouldn't be the case. If something really went wrong, it wouldn't be in this tone."
He quickly ran towards the outer disciples' accommodation area. It seemed that only by finding Lin Xuan could he know what was going on.
However, what made him even more troubled was that Lin Xuan was not in the room at all. Chen Dazheng asked the disciples around him, but no one knew where Lin Xuan had gone.
Helpless, he could only bite the bullet and go back to report to Elder Fang.
After hearing this, Elder Fang stroked his beard and said, "When he comes back, let him come to see me immediately."
"Yes."
Chen Dazheng said respectfully.
After Elder Fang left, Chen Dazheng suddenly slapped his forehead: "Oh, I forgot that I still have a sword that Lin Xuan just repaired in my hand!"
"Forget it, wait until Lin Xuan comes back and send it off."
He didn't dare to run to find Elder Fang now, he could only hope that Lin Xuan would come back soon.
At the same time, a storm was coming at the outer gate of Xuantian Sect.
The disciples of the Shenwei Group mobilized all their strength to search for the people Zhang Bin had contacted before his death. As a result, a disciple with a square face told a shocking news.
He was injured in a fight with others. Zhang Bin saw the signal he sent and went to rescue him.
Later, Zhang Bin and others tracked the man deep into the mountains and forests, and finally died in the mountains and forests.
Finally, the disciples of the Shenwei Group drew Lin Xuan's appearance, and a manhunt for Lin Xuan began outside the gate.
After extensive exploration, I finally found out the details of Lin Xuan.
"A sword slave who just joined the outer sect?"
When a young man with a scar on his face heard this, he became furious, "Do you think he can kill a fourth-level spiritual warrior and two third-level spiritual warriors?"
This young man is one of the leaders of the outer sect of the Shenwei Group. His name is Yan Kong, and his cultivation has reached the sixth level of Pulse Condensation Realm.
At this time, he couldn't help but became furious after hearing the news about Lin Xuan.
"Brother Kong."
The square-faced disciple trembled and said, "When I was fighting with the guy named Lin Xuan, I found that although he is a third-level spiritual warrior, his strength far exceeds that."
"Brother Kong, this is the only clue we have right now. Whether it's true or not, we need to capture it first. Otherwise, we won't be able to explain it when Zhang Rui comes back."
The disciple next to Yan Kong said.
"Let's go and take a look first!"
Yan Kong waved his hand and led a group of people towards Lin Xuan's residence.
…
In the residential area of the outer disciples, a group of disciples from the Shenwei Group suddenly appeared. They quickly surrounded a small house, and one of the disciples kicked the door open.
The disciples living around came out one after another and looked at the group of menacing Shenwei disciples with blank expressions on their faces.
"Brother Kong, that guy isn't here!"
Someone went in to investigate and then came out and said.
"Not there? Did he run away?"
Yan Kong frowned, "Hurry up and send people to search the area around the sect, and divide some people into waiting here. I don't believe he can still reach the sky!"
With an order, the outer disciples of the Shenwei Regiment began to move quickly, and the surrounding disciples gradually understood their actions. The name Lin Xuan was recognized by everyone for the first time.
And when they knew that Lin Xuan was just a young disciple who had just joined the outer sect without any background or support, they suddenly felt dizzy. It turns out that the ignorant are fearless, and a young disciple dared to challenge such a behemoth as the Divine Power Group.
After Tang Yu heard the news, she quickly ran to find Lin Xuan. She didn't expect that Lin Xuan would cause such a big trouble. Not only did he cause trouble for the Shenwei Group, but he also killed someone!
She hurried to Lin Xuan's residence, fearing that Lin Xuan had been taken away by the Shenwei Group.
Fortunately, apart from seeing a room full of Shenwei Regiment disciples, Lin Xuan was not seen at all.
"You little bastard, you still know how to escape, huh!"
Tang Yu kept scolding Lin Xuan in his heart.
After turning around and not finding Lin Xuan, she stamped her feet angrily and then exclaimed angrily.He screamed and walked away.
